notes.title: COMBAT UPDATE LIVE
notes.content:
COMBAT UPDATE IS HERE!

Create ally and enemy tank armies and fight to the death in 9 unique levels. Operate individual friendly tanks in first person mode to engage in the combat from below. Choose assault points and outsmart the enemy to your advantage. Pause the battle to spawn more tanks or have both teams of tanks continuously respawn.

Explore Custom Arenas mode and build your own arenas in 8 different pre-built biomes. The possibilities are endless.
